key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1A4FA
name: walk_offset_dispatch_loop
description: Calls through a pointer formed by adding a relative word offset read from the current table entry, and steps a 16-bit accumulator by a stride on each pass. It returns the remaining count, or -1 if the call result reaches zero before the count is exhausted.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1A524
name: step_clipped_dda_points
description: Steps a pair of 32-bit fixed-point coordinates by per-step deltas and checks their integer parts against a 320 by 168 window. A handler is called for each in-window point, with an extra call when the position leaves the window, and the loop ends once the counter goes negative.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1A59C
name: walk_clipped_fixed_point_path
description: Steps a pair of 32-bit fixed-point coordinates by per-step deltas and calls a handler for each point inside a 320 by 168 window. The position leaving the window ends the inner loop, and the counter argument decides when the routine returns.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1A5C0
name: walk_clipped_point_run
description: Calls a handler twice before its loop, then steps two fixed-point coordinates by per-step deltas. It calls the handler for each point inside a 320 by 168 window and returns when the counter argument goes negative.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1AA56
name: stub_immediate_return
description: Contains only a return, so it performs no work. It is reached through a stored pointer rather than a direct call.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1AA58
name: call_four_routines_then_return
description: Calls the same unnamed routine four times in succession and then returns, with no other operations. It is referenced from a data pointer, so it acts as a fixed sequence of invocations.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1AA72

description: Rejects blocks that fall outside a 320 by 168 window, then copies 16-bit word rows into four bitplanes 8000 bytes apart with a 40-byte row stride. Blocks not aligned to 16 pixels are shifted with a mask into a single bitplane, and other widths are delegated to a routine picked from a table.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1AA88

Blocks not aligned to 16 pixels are shifted with a mask into a single bitplane, and other widths are delegated to a routine picked from a table.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1AB0C
name: copy_block_to_four_planes
description: Copies rows of 32-bit words from a source block into four bitplanes 8000 bytes apart, with a 40-byte row stride. A separate path copies a single long per row, and other widths are delegated to a routine picked from a table.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1AB4A
name: copy_rows_to_four_planes
description: Copies rows of ten 32-bit words from a source block into four bitplanes 8000 bytes apart, with a 40-byte row stride. Rows of any other width are delegated to a routine picked from a table.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1ABF2
name: call_table_routine_four_loops
description: Looks up a routine pointer in a table at an offset taken from a register, then calls that routine in four nested count-down loops, one per counter register. Each loop runs until its counter reaches negative one.

name: blit_masked_shift_column
description: For a one-word-wide block, merges each shifted source word into the matching row of the fourth bitplane while keeping the destination bits outside the mask. For wider blocks it calls an unnamed routine four times and returns.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1AD3E
name: merge_shifted_words_masked
description: Repeatedly ORs each source word, shifted by a count, into a destination word after masking the destination's bits, then advances the destination by 40 bytes and the source by one word. The loop ends when its counter goes negative.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1AD56
name: call_routine_four_times
description: Calls the same unnamed routine four times in a row and then returns, with no other operations. It has no data handling of its own, so it only sequences four invocations.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1AD78
name: merge_shifted_word_rows
description: For each row, shifts consecutive 16-bit source words left by a count, masks the destination with a register value, and ORs the two together. The destination advances two bytes per word and 40 bytes per row, and the loop ends when the row counter goes negative.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1AF14

name: return_immediately
description: Executes a return with no other operations, so the routine performs no work and changes no data.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1AF28
name: shift_input_left_five
description: Returns the 16-bit input value shifted left by five bits. It reads no memory and has no side effects.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1AF38
name: xor_word_at_indexed_offset
description: Computes an address from a base register, a fixed offset, and the input word doubled, then XORs a second register value into the 16-bit word stored there.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1B30E
name: walk_relative_handler_chain
description: Loads a table pointer from a global slot and calls handlers located by relative offsets stored in that table, counting down two counters. It sequences a final pair of handler calls and returns early when a flag argument is nonzero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1B390
name: call_routine_twice
description: Calls the same unnamed routine twice in succession and then returns, with no other operations.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1B3AE
name: clamp_counter_then_dispatch
description: Clamps a counter so that the sum of two position values stays below 198, and skips the work if the result would be negative. If the low nibble of the first argument is zero it calls an unnamed routine, then invokes table handlers at a fixed offset once per counter step.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1B3EE
name: call_offset_handler_loop
description: Repeatedly calls a handler found at a fixed offset within a structure, decrementing a counter until it goes negative. Each pass uses the base pointer that the previous call returned.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1B42C
name: multiply_and_scale_to_range
description: Multiplies the first 16-bit input by a second register value, then halves the product and a companion product together until both fit within plus or minus 7935. It returns the scaled first product.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1B448
name: scale_pair_into_range
description: Halves the first value until it is at most 7935 and halves the second value once for each halving of the first. It then halves the second value alone until it lies within plus or minus 7935, leaving both results in the input registers.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1B454
name: scale_value_into_range
description: Halves a 16-bit value repeatedly until it lies within plus or minus 7935, with the sign deciding which bound is tested.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1B464
name: shrink_positive_value_to_range
description: Halves a 16-bit value repeatedly until it is no more than 7935. Negative values are not handled, so only values above the limit change.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1B470
name: stub_immediate_return
description: Contains only a return, so it performs no work.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1B472
name: multiply_scale_to_long_result
description: Multiplies the first input by a second register value and forms a 32-bit result from the high half of the product. It then halves that result and a companion product until both fit within plus or minus 7935, and returns the 32-bit result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1B48E
name: scale_pair_into_range
description: Halves the first value until it is at most 7935 and halves the second value once for each halving of the first. It then halves the second value alone until it lies within plus or minus 7935, leaving both results in the input registers.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1B49A
name: scale_value_into_range
description: Halves a 16-bit value repeatedly until it lies within plus or minus 7935, with the sign deciding which bound is tested.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1B4AA
name: shrink_positive_value_to_range
description: Halves a 16-bit value repeatedly until it is no more than 7935. Negative values are not handled, so only values above the limit change.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1B4B6
name: stub_immediate_return
description: Contains only a return, so it performs no work.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1B4B8
name: multiply_pair_table_scale_full
description: Shifts two 32-bit components right until the scale and the first component fit a 16-bit range, then multiplies both by a lookup-table entry indexed from the scale. The two products are returned packed into one 64-bit value, with a second halving pass for large results.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1B4D4
name: multiply_pair_table_scale_neg
description: Shifts two 32-bit components right while the first is below the most negative 16-bit value, then multiplies both by a lookup-table entry indexed from the scale. The two products are returned packed into one 64-bit value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1B4EC
name: multiply_pair_table_scale_guarded
description: Shifts the first component and the scale together only when the scale lies inside a sign-dependent range, then multiplies both components by a lookup-table entry. The two products are returned packed into one 64-bit value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1B514
name: multiply_pair_table_scale_range
description: Shifts two components right until the first fits a 16-bit range, then multiplies both by a lookup-table entry indexed from the scale. The two products are returned packed into one 64-bit value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1B52C
name: multiply_pair_table_scale_ordered
description: Orders the two components by magnitude, shifts them until they fit a 16-bit range, then multiplies both by a lookup-table entry indexed from the scale. The two products are returned packed into one 64-bit value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1B562
name: scale_pair_table_then_halve
description: Multiplies the first input by a lookup-table entry indexed from the scale, then halves that product and the second input together until both fit within plus or minus 7935. It returns the scaled first value packed with the second.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1B56E
name: multiply_pair_by_table_entry
description: Multiplies both inputs by one lookup-table entry chosen from the high bits of the scale argument. It returns the two shifted products packed into one 64-bit value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1B584
name: reduce_scale_then_table_multiply
description: Halves both inputs and the scale value repeatedly until the scale fits within 32767, then multiplies both inputs by a lookup-table entry indexed from the scale. It returns the two products packed into one 64-bit value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1BDA8
name: offset_result_above_threshold
description: When the input exceeds 63, calls an unnamed routine and returns its result plus 160. Otherwise it returns the most negative signed 16-bit value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1BDC2
name: return_minimum_word_constant
description: Returns the constant 32768 as a 16-bit value, which reads as the most negative signed 16-bit value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1BDCC
name: normalize_vector_three_components
description: Forms the sum of the squares of three fixed-point inputs, takes its iterative square root, and divides each input by that root with repeated subtraction. It returns the product of the last normalized value and a fourth input as a 64-bit result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1BE1C
name: normalize_three_by_sqrt
description: Takes a fixed-point value and computes its iterative square root, then divides three other fixed-point inputs by that root using repeated subtraction. It returns the product of the last divided value and a further input as a 64-bit result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1BF30
name: find_leading_power_of_two
description: Takes a 16-bit value from an unnamed routine, halves it, and doubles the result until its top bit is set. It returns the last value reached before that, masked to 15 bits, or zero if the halved value is zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1BF4E
name: retrieve_and_halve_value
description: Calls an unnamed routine to obtain a 16-bit value and returns that value shifted right by one bit.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1BF60
name: table_lookup_vector_magnitude
description: Sums the squares of three 16-bit inputs and selects a shift and lookup-table entry from the size of that sum. It returns the looked-up value, scaled by the shift, as a 32-bit result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1BF6A
name: table_lookup_scaled_magnitude
description: Selects a shift and lookup-table entry from the size of a 32-bit input and returns the looked-up value, scaled by the shift. Large inputs take a separate indexed path.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1BF8C
name: lookup_table_halved_by_index
description: Indexes the lookup table with bits of the 16-bit input and returns the table entry shifted right by one bit.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1BF9A
name: lookup_table_word_by_index
description: Returns the lookup-table word addressed by the upper bits of the 16-bit input.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1BFA6
name: table_lookup_range_magnitude
description: Selects a lookup-table entry and shift from the size of a 32-bit input across three magnitude ranges. It returns the looked-up value, scaled by the chosen shift.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1BFC4
name: lookup_table_scaled_entry
description: Shifts a 32-bit input, indexes the lookup table with its upper bits, and returns the entry shifted right by three bits.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1BFD4
name: lookup_table_shifted_entry
description: Shifts a 32-bit input left by six bits, indexes the lookup table with the shifted upper bits, and returns the entry shifted right by five bits.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1CFE4
name: dot_product_matrix_columns
description: Computes two dot products between the three register inputs and the stored matrix columns at offsets zero and one, doubling each result. It returns both as one 64-bit value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1D028
name: dot_product_matrix_rows
description: Computes two dot products between the three register inputs and the stored vectors at the first and second rows of the matrix, doubling each result. It returns both as one 64-bit value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1D060
name: build_rotation_matrix_from_angles
description: Looks up sine and cosine values for two angles in a quarter-turn-offset sine table, applies the sign of each angle, and writes a nine-entry rotation matrix with a zero in its eighth position. The product terms are doubled before being stored.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1D084
name: build_rotation_matrix_stack_angles
description: Looks up sine and cosine values for two angles passed on the stack, applies the sign of each angle, and writes a nine-entry rotation matrix with a zero in its eighth position. The product terms are doubled before being stored.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1D0A6
name: build_rotation_matrix_partial
description: Looks up one sine-table value for an angle, combines it with two register values to form a rotation matrix, and writes the nine entries with a zero in its eighth position.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1D0C8
name: build_rotation_matrix_signed_angle
description: Looks up a sine-table value for an angle, takes the sign from a second angle, and writes a nine-entry rotation matrix with a zero in its eighth position. The product terms are doubled before being stored.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1D0E6
name: build_rotation_matrix_from_registers
description: Writes a nine-entry rotation matrix with a zero in its eighth position from sine and cosine values held in the register inputs, with one sine-table lookup for the remaining term.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1D140
name: build_negated_rotation_matrix
description: Looks up sine and cosine values for two angles, applies each angle's sign, and writes a nine-entry matrix in which several entries are negated. The sixth entry is zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1D164
name: build_negated_rotation_matrix_stack
description: Looks up sine and cosine values for two angles passed on the stack and writes a nine-entry matrix in which several entries are negated. The sixth entry is zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1D186
name: build_negated_rotation_matrix_mixed
description: Looks up sine and cosine values for one stored angle and combines them with a register angle to write a nine-entry matrix with several negated entries. The sixth entry is zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1D1A8
name: build_negated_rotation_matrix_pair
description: Looks up sine and cosine values for two register-supplied angles and writes a nine-entry matrix with several negated entries. The sixth entry is zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1D1C6
name: build_inverse_rotation_matrix
description: Writes a nine-entry rotation matrix that is transposed and negated, using one sine-table value and register inputs. The sixth entry is zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1D224
name: compute_sine_cosine_product_pair
description: Looks up sine and cosine values for two angles, applies each angle's sign, and returns two products packed into one 64-bit value. The first product is doubled.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1D246
name: compute_table_product_pair_signed
description: Multiplies a stored table value by a sign-adjusted angle component and returns two products packed into one 64-bit value. The first product is doubled.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1D264
name: compute_table_product_pair_mixed
description: Multiplies a stored table value by a register input and a sign-adjusted table value, returning two products packed into one 64-bit value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1D286
name: compute_scaled_product_pair
description: Forms a product of two register inputs and a product involving a stored table value, then packs both into one 64-bit result with a shift.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1D2A4
name: compute_vector_component
description: Computes a product of two register inputs and a second product involving a stored table value, then combines them into a 64-bit result with bit shifts and a sign inversion.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1D2BE
name: clip_line_to_viewport
description: Clips a line segment to a 320 by 168 window by repeated halving steps, and returns the clipped endpoint coordinates as one packed 64-bit value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1D316
name: clip_line_against_row_bounds
description: Clips a line segment against the 168-row limit of the viewport by repeated halving steps, and returns the clipped endpoint coordinates as one packed 64-bit value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1D39A
name: interpolate_point_halving
description: Advances a pair of 32-bit fixed-point coordinates in halving steps until the step size drops below 64, then returns their integer parts packed into one 64-bit value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1D3C8
name: clip_line_below_row_168
description: Returns its endpoint pair unchanged when the vertical position is at most 168. Otherwise it clips against that bottom boundary by repeated halving steps and returns the clipped pair packed into one 64-bit value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1D4AC
name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Pseudo-code is only a return, and the recovered instruction count suggests data decoded as code. No behaviour can be established from this evidence.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Pseudo-code is only a return, and the recovered instruction count suggests data decoded as code. No behaviour can be established from this evidence.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Pseudo-code is only a return, and the recovered instruction count suggests data decoded as code. No behaviour can be established from this evidence.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1D908
name: rotate_vector_pair_by_angle
description: Looks up sine and cosine values for an angle with a quarter-turn offset, then rotates two stored three-component vectors by that angle in place, using doubled products.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1D924
name: rotate_vector_pair_by_table
description: Looks up sine and cosine values from a table addressed through a second register, then rotates two stored three-component vectors in place using doubled products.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1D946
name: transform_vector_components
description: Rotates two stored three-component vectors in place using sine and cosine values supplied in registers, writing each result back through its input pointer.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1DC1E
name: insert_sorted_tree_node
description: Walks a binary search tree of nodes that each hold a key and two child links, following right links while the stored key is smaller and left links otherwise. It attaches the new node at the first empty link and sets its key with empty child links.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1DC36
name: insert_tree_node_from_head
description: Starts from the head node, following child links that lead toward the new key and stopping at the first empty link. It stores the new node there with the key and empty child links, comparing keys as unsigned values.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1DC70
name: initialise_list_head_globals
description: Initialises a global list head node by zeroing its links and key and storing a fixed negative value in its data field. It also sets several global configuration variables to constants and points one of them at the node's data area.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1DC74
name: reset_list_head_node
description: Resets the global list head node by zeroing its links, setting its key to a fixed negative value and re-initialising the same global configuration values as the initialiser.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1DCC8
name: set_globals_to_stack_buffer
description: Stores the address of a 65434-byte local stack buffer into three global pointer variables.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1DCE4
name: traverse_list_calling_handlers
description: Walks a chain of nodes and, for each node, calls a handler selected from a table by an offset stored in the node. Node pointers are kept on the stack as the walk proceeds.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1DCEE
name: traverse_node_chain_from_global
description: Walks a chain of nodes starting from a global pointer, and calls a handler selected from a table by an offset stored in each node.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1E3E4
name: stub_immediate_return
description: Contains only a return, so it performs no work.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1E3E6
name: transform_three_vectors_by_matrix
description: When a cached flag in the node differs from the global value, it calls an unnamed routine, multiplies the node's stored matrix by three input vectors, and stores the three results in the node. It then updates the cached flag.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1E510
name: accumulate_matrix_vector_product
description: Multiplies the node's stored matrix by a scaled input vector, with the shift chosen from the vector's size. It adds the products into three 64-bit accumulators in the node and updates the cached flag.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1E56E
name: accumulate_matrix_vector_product_args
description: Performs the same matrix-vector accumulation as its neighbour, but takes the input vector and accumulator addends as arguments. It adds the products into three 64-bit accumulators in the node and updates the cached flag.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1E5E8
name: store_shifted_accumulated_values
description: Shifts three input values right by a count and adds each to a parameter, storing the sums with carry-derived high words into the node's accumulator fields. It then records the cached flag.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1E634
name: get_cached_transformed_vector
description: Returns a cached 64-bit vector from the node when its cache flag matches the global value. Otherwise it recomputes the transformed values from the stored matrix and accumulators, updates the cache, and returns the leading pair.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1E63A
name: get_cached_transform_byte_compare
description: Uses the same caching pattern as its neighbour, but compares the cache flag with a byte passed in a register. It returns the cached 64-bit vector when they match and recomputes it otherwise.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1E68A
name: return_cached_vector_pair
description: Returns the 64-bit vector stored at the node's cache fields without recomputation.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1E692
name: copy_accumulators_to_cache
description: Copies six 32-bit values from the node's source fields into its cache fields and stores the global cache flag in the node.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1E69C
name: difference_of_node_vectors
description: Returns the component-wise difference between two node positions as a 64-bit value. When the cache flags indicate a mirrored case it negates the second node's values, and otherwise it falls back to an unnamed routine for the first position.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1E6D0
name: difference_of_node_pairs_simple
description: Returns the 64-bit difference between two node positions when their flags match. Otherwise it falls back to an unnamed routine for the first position.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1E6FE
name: negate_and_concat_a3_fields
description: Reads two 32-bit fields at offsets 44 and 48 from the A3 base, negates each, and returns both as one 64-bit value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1E712
name: scale_and_store_frame_values
description: Stores a shifted, doubled 16-bit field into a frame slot and stores a high byte in another. It halves a frame value until it is at most 32767, then calls an unnamed routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1E736
name: store_high_byte_and_call
description: Stores the high byte of a 16-bit field from one structure into a frame slot, then calls an unnamed routine and returns.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1E756
name: compute_bitmask_and_store
description: Shifts one bit left by the difference between a register value and a 16-bit field in the source structure, clamping a negative result to 127. It stores that byte in the destination structure along with a pair of minimum-value 16-bit words.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1E772
name: project_node_and_queue_byte
description: Computes a three-by-three transform of the node's position and a depth value from the node's data. When the depth is in range it sets the node's projected values, and otherwise it sets them to the minimum value, possibly appending a fixed byte to a queue.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1E7E2
name: transform_node_into_frame_slots
description: Computes a shift from a depth value and stores a depth byte in the node. It then transforms the node's vector by one of two stored matrix sets, writing the results into frame slots, and sets two result words to the minimum value when the depth test fails.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1E84C
name: transform_vector_into_frame_slots
description: Computes a shift from a depth value and transforms a node vector by the source matrix, writing the results into frame slots. It sets the node's two result words to the minimum value when the depth test fails.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1E934
name: multiply_matrix_into_frame_slots
description: Multiplies a matrix stored at a fixed offset in the source structure by the node's matrix, storing nine products in frame slots. It then appends a fixed byte value to the queue when a pending counter is nonzero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1E93A
name: multiply_matrices_into_frame_slots
description: Optionally advances to a second matrix block when a flag is set, then multiplies it by another matrix and stores nine products in frame slots. It appends a fixed byte value to the queue when a pending counter is nonzero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1EA8E
name: store_min_and_copy_matrix
description: Sets two result words to the minimum 16-bit value, then either copies nine words of a matrix into frame slots or multiplies them with the node's matrix, depending on flags. It appends a fixed byte value to the queue when a pending counter is nonzero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1EA9A
name: append_pending_queue_byte
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then calls two more, and appends a fixed byte value to the queue when a pending counter is nonzero. The counter is cleared afterwards.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1EAA6
name: update_global_pointer_state
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then calls two more. If a pending flag is set, it stores a fixed byte value at the queue pointer, advances that pointer, and clears the flag.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1EB32
name: append_queue_byte_and_return
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then calls two more. When a pending flag is set it stores a fixed byte value at the queue pointer, advances the pointer and clears the flag, then returns.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1EBC6
name: normalize_and_transform_vectors
description: Finds a common right-shift for three input vectors so their values fit a 16-bit range, then multiplies two stored three-by-three coefficient sets by the scaled values. The six results are written into the local frame as fixed-point words.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1ECC6
name: compute_visibility_margin
description: Adds a scaled field to a frame value and compares two other frame values against it, returning the reduced margin. The result is set to zero when a bounds check fails.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1ED02
name: clear_strided_word_table
description: Clears 16-bit fields in a table at fixed strides, with the count taken from a structure field and the loop unrolled in blocks of ten. Nothing is cleared when the count is below the first threshold.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1ED10
name: clear_structured_memory
description: Zeroes several fixed-offset fields in a local structure, then clears 16-bit fields in a strided table whose count is derived from an input register. The loop is unrolled in blocks of ten.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1F68C
name: fill_stack_with_constant
description: Fills a run of stack words with the fixed 16-bit constant 32896, with the count taken from a structure field minus three. Nothing is written when the count is negative.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1FD0C
name: project_quad_and_queue_commands
description: Returns early when the position lies outside the 320 by 168 window. Otherwise it computes four projected corner positions from a size value and a matrix, writes them into frame slots, and appends fixed command words to the queue, allocating a cache slot where one is needed.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1FD26
name: project_quad_with_size_test
description: Returns early when the position lies outside the 320 by 168 window or a depth test fails. Otherwise it projects four corner positions from a size value and a matrix, writes them into the output slots, and appends fixed command words to the queue.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1FD42
name: project_quad_nonzero_check
description: Returns early when the sum of the two position inputs is zero or overflows. Otherwise it projects four corner positions from a size value and a matrix, and appends fixed command words to the queue.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1FDAC
name: project_quad_from_stack_args
description: Projects four corner positions from a size value and a matrix, using two position values passed on the stack, and writes them into the output slots. It appends fixed command words to the queue and allocates a cache slot where one is needed.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1FDB0
name: project_quad_from_stack_pair
description: Projects four corner positions from a size value and a matrix, using a stack-passed position pair, and writes them into the output slots. It appends fixed command words to the queue and allocates a cache slot where one is needed.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1FE18
name: project_quad_into_entry
description: Writes a cache index and a projected quad into one output entry, using a size value and a matrix. It stores the corner coordinates and a pair of cache-derived words in the entry.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1FE2A
name: store_index_and_project_quad
description: Stores a byte index into a table and writes a cache word into the output entry. It then projects four corner positions from a size value and a matrix and writes them into the entry.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1FE5A
name: project_quad_stack_into_entry
description: Stores a cache word in an output entry, then projects four corner positions from a size value and a matrix using stack-passed position values. The corner coordinates are written into the entry and a second cache word is stored at a fixed slot.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1FE6C
name: store_entry_and_project_quad
description: Stores a byte index and a cache word into table slots, then projects four corner positions from a size value and a matrix. The corner coordinates are written into the output slots, with a sign-adjusted offset applied.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1FF88
name: queue_positioned_command_entry
description: Appends a command entry to the queue when the position lies within the 320 by 168 window, using a fixed opcode that changes when a flag is set. The entry holds the two coordinates, a cache-derived word, and a second cache word derived from the mode.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1FF94
name: queue_positioned_command_entry_flagged
description: Derives a mode word from a flag and a register value, then appends a command entry to the queue when the position lies within the 320 by 168 window. Positions outside the window produce a different fixed-opcode entry.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1FFF6
name: queue_flagged_command_entry
description: Appends a command entry with a fixed opcode, two coordinate arguments and a cache-derived word pair to the queue. When a flag is set the opcode changes and both coordinates are decremented by one.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:1FFFA
name: queue_command_entry_from_args
description: Appends a command entry with a fixed opcode, two coordinate arguments and a cache-derived word pair to the queue. When a flag is set the opcode changes and both coordinates are decremented by one.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2005C
name: store_cache_words_in_entry
description: Stores a byte index and a cache word into an output entry, deriving the second cache slot from a masked register value. It stores the cache word in one field of the entry and the derived slot word in another.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2006E
name: store_cache_index_and_word
description: Stores a byte index into a table and a cache word into an output entry. It then stores a second cache word derived from a masked register value in the same entry.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:200A2
name: store_cache_word_in_entry
description: Stores a cache word, allocated from the global cache table when needed, into a fixed field of an output entry.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:200B4
name: append_indexed_word_record
description: Stores a byte index into a table and appends a word record at the running offset of a counter structure, then advances that counter by four. The same word is stored in an output field.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:200C8
name: queue_scaled_command_entry
description: Derives a scale from a size value and a shift. When the scale is zero it queues a fixed-opcode entry with zero offsets, and otherwise it queues a positioned command entry with a cache-derived word when the position lies within the 320 by 168 window.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:200E0
name: queue_scaled_command_entry_div
description: Derives a scale by dividing a shifted size value by a second size value. When the scale is zero it queues a fixed-opcode entry with zero offsets, and otherwise it queues a positioned command entry when the position lies within the 320 by 168 window.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:20116
name: queue_flagged_scaled_command
description: When a flag is set, derives a scale from a size value and a shift, then queues a positioned command entry inside the 320 by 168 window. Otherwise it queues a fixed-opcode entry.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:20148
name: queue_fixed_command_entry
description: Queues a fixed-opcode command entry holding two coordinates from an unnamed routine and a register-supplied word, with a cache-derived word stored in the entry.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2014C
name: queue_fixed_command_entry_alt
description: Queues a fixed-opcode command entry holding two coordinates from an unnamed routine and a register-supplied word. A cache-derived word is stored in the entry.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2019C
name: store_indexed_word_in_entry
description: Stores a cache word, allocated from the global cache table when needed, into a fixed field of an output entry, with the register value as a second field.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:201AE
name: append_indexed_word_record_b
description: Stores a byte index into a table and appends a word record at the running offset of a counter structure, then advances that counter by four. The same word is stored in an output field.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:21AFE
name: rotate_frame_vector_pair_signed
description: Negates frame vectors according to flag bits. When the resulting angle word is nonzero, it rotates a frame vector pair by that angle using sine-table lookups with a quarter-turn offset and writes the results back into the frame.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:21C1E
name: rotate_frame_pair_by_angle
description: Reads an angle word from a stored pointer, derives sine and cosine from the sine table with a quarter-turn offset, and rotates a pair of frame vectors in place.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:21C2A
name: rotate_frame_pair_from_register
description: Takes an angle word from a table indexed by a doubled register value, derives sine and cosine with a quarter-turn offset, and rotates a pair of frame vectors in place. The pair's offsets come from a global table indexed by a register value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:21C3C
name: rotate_frame_pair_by_index
description: Reads an angle word from a frame table at an index taken from a register, derives sine and cosine with a quarter-turn offset, and rotates a pair of frame vectors in place.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:21C68
name: rotate_frame_pair_sine_indices
description: Rotates two frame vectors located at offsets given by two register indices, using a sine and cosine pair read from a table at the supplied index. The two results are written back in place.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:21C8A
name: rotate_frame_pair_given_sine
description: Rotates two frame vectors located at offsets given by register indices, using a sine value from a table and a cosine value supplied directly in a register. The results are written back in place.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:22152
name: store_maximum_byte_value
description: Stores the constant 255 into a global variable and returns, with no other effect.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2371C
name: stub_undecompiled_routine
description: No pseudo-code could be recovered because decompilation timed out, so its behaviour cannot be established. The routine has 31 instructions, is called by two routines, and calls two unnamed routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:237C6
name: call_marked_routine_three_times
description: Shifts three frame values right by a computed count when a frame counter lags behind, then calls an unnamed routine three times. Before each call it stores a marker word in a local table, and it sets a frame byte to 2 between the second and third calls.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:237D0
name: call_routine_thrice_from_input
description: Stores an argument value in the frame and calls an unnamed routine three times, writing a marker word to a local table before each call. A frame byte is set to 2 between the second and third calls.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:23C22
name: dispatch_global_table_handler
description: Looks up a handler pointer in the global table at an index derived from the input word, then looks up a second entry and calls it through that pointer.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:23DB2
name: expand_byte_command_stream
description: Copies bytes from a table-selected source to a destination until a zero byte. Values above 252 act as commands: 255 calls an unnamed routine and skips three source bytes, 254 writes a pair of bytes built from the following source bytes, and other high values write a shorter pair.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:23DC6
name: expand_stream_from_global_table
description: Expands a byte stream whose source is selected by an index into a global table, copying bytes until a zero byte. Values above 252 act as commands: 255 calls an unnamed routine and skips three source bytes, 254 writes a pair of bytes built from the following source bytes, and other high values write a shorter pair.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:23DCE
name: expand_byte_stream_from_offset
description: Expands a byte stream whose source starts at an offset from a base pointer, copying bytes until a zero byte. Values above 252 act as commands: 255 calls an unnamed routine and skips three source bytes, 254 writes a pair of bytes built from the following source bytes, and other high values write a shorter pair.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:23DDA
name: expand_byte_stream_inline_copy
description: Expands the same command encoding as its neighbours with a different loop structure, copying bytes until a zero byte and handling commands above 252 between copies. Each command writes a prefix byte followed by bytes taken from the source.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:23DE6
name: expand_stream_pending_command
description: Handles a command byte already held in a register, then copies bytes until a zero byte. Further commands above 252 are processed as in its neighbours, with 255 calling an unnamed routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:23DF8
name: expand_byte_stream_fixed_prefix
description: Writes a fixed prefix byte and the first source byte, then copies bytes until a zero byte. Commands above 252 are handled as in its neighbours, with 255 calling an unnamed routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:23E00
name: expand_byte_stream_after_call
description: Calls an unnamed routine, skips two source bytes, then copies bytes until a zero byte. Values above 252 act as commands: 255 restarts the outer loop with another call to an unnamed routine, 254 writes a pair of bytes built from the following source bytes, and other high values write a shorter pair.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:23E12
name: dispatch_indexed_table_handler
description: Calls a handler pointer taken from a table at an offset computed from the input word, using a second fixed lookup in the table to find it.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:23E22
name: wrap_text_at_width
description: Copies text while subtracting each character's width, read from a global table, from a remaining width counter. When a character overflows the line, it searches back to the previous space and replaces that space with a carriage-return code, returning if the search passes the start of the text.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:23E60
name: stub_immediate_return
description: Contains only a return, so it performs no work.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:24AD2
name: update_flag_table_entries
description: Clears three frame flag fields, then either decrements a 16-bit counter by half a frame value and sets the node's counter to minus one, or scans a flag table and calls unnamed routines for matching entries. It returns two packed flag bytes.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:24AD8
name: update_flag_table_entries_alt
description: Sets a frame flag byte to 255 and clears two other frame fields, then either decrements a 16-bit counter by half a frame value and resets the node's counter, or scans a flag table and calls unnamed routines for matching entries. It returns two packed flag bytes.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:24B2C
name: scan_flag_table_for_matches
description: Scans a flag table downward from a fixed index, calling unnamed routines for entries whose flag bit is clear and skipping entries whose type matches a stored byte. It returns two packed flag bytes.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:24B94
name: find_next_valid_entity
description: Walks a table of entity descriptors downward from a 16-bit index, skipping entries whose flag bits are set or whose type matches the reference entity. When the fields of the two entities do not match, it fetches the next entity pair.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:24BDE
name: compute_pair_contact_flags
description: Computes the squared size of two 64-bit position deltas in fixed point and compares it with a stored threshold, returning zero when the entities are separated. Otherwise it normalises the deltas by shifting, updates contact flag bytes, and walks a table of candidate entries.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:24C4A
name: compute_pair_contact_status
description: Shifts two position deltas and a scale value, forms a squared magnitude in fixed point, and compares it with a second magnitude. When the first is larger it sets flag bits, normalises the vector, and returns the flag byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:24C6E
name: compute_pair_contact_flags_b
description: Shifts two position deltas and a scale value by a shared count, then computes squared magnitudes in fixed point and compares them. When the first is larger it sets flag bits and normalises the vector; otherwise it updates the stored contact fields and returns the flag byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:24DDE
name: apply_rotation_and_scale
description: Stores the input position words into the node, then shifts three 32-bit components by a computed count and writes them to the node's vector fields. A scale value is incremented when a computed comparison is negative, and a flag byte is updated.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:24EDC
name: calculate_clamped_shifted_value
description: Computes an iterative square root of an input and subtracts a second value, clamping negative results to zero. It shifts the result by a count, stores it when a sign test passes, and sets a flag bit when two counters differ.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:24F44
name: return_zero_constant
description: Returns the constant zero and has no other effect.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:24F4C
name: resolve_pair_contact_response
description: Walks a table of candidate partners for an entity, computing a scaled interaction term for each. It records a contact flag and, when both entities are in range, adjusts their 32-bit state fields by a third of the differences and calls an unnamed routine; it returns the flag byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2504E
name: damp_and_flip_state_fields
description: Negates a quarter of each of three 32-bit state fields and calls an unnamed routine when a 16-bit field exceeds 16. It returns a flag byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2508C
name: resolve_pair_contact_response_b
description: Walks a table of candidate partners for an entity, computing a scaled interaction term for each. It records a contact flag and, when both entities are in range, adjusts their 32-bit state fields by a third of the differences and calls an unnamed routine; it returns the flag byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:250FC
name: return_flag_byte
description: Returns a flag byte from the frame without changing any state.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:25106
name: scan_contact_bytecode_table
description: Scales two position values by a shared shift, then walks a byte-coded table. Each entry either calls an unnamed routine or branches on its flag bits, and the result combines a flag byte with computed components.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:251B0
name: transform_and_scan_bytecode_table
description: Writes three transformed components of the input vector into the node, using a stored matrix, then walks a byte-coded table. Each entry either calls an unnamed routine or branches on its flag bits, and the result is a 64-bit flag value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:251CC
name: transform_vector_and_scan_table
description: Multiplies a stored three-by-three matrix by three inputs and writes the results into the node, then walks a byte-coded table in the same way as its neighbour.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:25250
name: continue_bytecode_table_scan
description: Resumes walking a byte-coded table at its current pointer, calling unnamed routines for entries whose flag bits match and branching on the high bits of each entry.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2525A
name: resume_bytecode_table_scan_flags
description: Walks a byte-coded table, testing one bit of the input value against each entry's flags and calling unnamed routines for matching entries.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:25290
name: return_constant_long
description: Returns a 64-bit constant with one set in the upper 32 bits and zero in the lower word.
